risks.risk: Model/brand mismatch (seller may be calling it 'Ryker' but the photo doesn’t confirm the exact make/model).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the bike’s VIN/serial plate and a close-up of the front badge/brand/model label (plus a photo of the dashboard/odometer).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified 3-wheel trike with unknown model; use the lowest comparable that matches '3-wheel trike/motorcycle' category.

risks.risk: Tyres may not be brand new (tread wear, sidewall cracking, or replacement quality).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of both front and rear tyres showing tread pattern and sidewall date codes (DOT) and a short video rolling the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres not guaranteed new (worst case: normal wear).

risks.risk: Custom duty/legality not proven (could be missing documents or not fully cleared).
risks.proof: Ask for scanned/clear photos of customs clearance documents (duty receipt, bill of entry, and any import paperwork) and the VIN matching the documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if documentation is not confirmed (worst case: buyer may need to re-verify/lose time).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition not proven (no start test; could have engine/transmission issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a video of a cold start, idling, gear engagement/drive test, and brake test (front and rear).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: Damage in transit or hidden body/structural issues (only one distant photo inside a van).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of frame/underbody, both sides, front suspension, and close-ups of any dents/scratches; plus a video showing steering lock-to-lock.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible cosmetic/handling issues until inspected.

proof_requests: Clear photos of VIN/serial plate and any badge/model label (front and side), plus dashboard/odometer photo.
Tyre close-ups: tread + DOT date codes for all tyres (front and rear).
Custom duty/import documents: bill of entry, duty receipt, and any clearance papers; VIN must match documents.
Video proof: cold start, idling, drive/ride test, and brake test (front + rear).
More condition photos: both sides, underbody/frame, suspension, and any damage points.
response.reason: The photo doesn’t confirm the exact make/model (seller’s 'Ryker' claim is not readable), and key value drivers (duty documents, tyre condition, and working/mechanical status) are not proven. Without these, a worst-case price cannot be confidently set from the provided comparables.
